subject: ApexWorks x Redwood — multi-sku co-sell demo: logistics & runbook
messages:
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa@apexworks.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Gupta <r.gupta@si-integrators.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Partner Scheduling <aws-partner-scheduling@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ApexWorks x Redwood — multi-sku co-sell demo: logistics & runbook

Hi Connor / Vanessa / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’d like to lock a 30-minute co-sell demo with our mutual SI (Rajesh) and AWS rep present so we can show the three SKU configurations (hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and the recommended routing/fallback in a single run. Goal: align messaging for marketplace listing and capture any technical blockers before the reseller packet is finalized.

High level ask:
- 30 minute demo + 10 minutes of buffer for follow-ups
- A short runbook PDF (one pager) and a demo agenda attached would be ideal
- Prefer week of Apr 25; we have strong APAC attendance so early Pacific / late APAC windows are preferred

Proposed initial slots (we can be flexible):
- Tue Apr 25 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC
- Wed Apr 26 07:30 PT / 14:30 UTC
- Thu Apr 27 20:00 PT / Fri Apr 28 03:00 UTC (APAC-friendly)

I attached a draft runbook (apex-demo-runbook-v2.pdf) and a sample agenda (apex-demo-agenda-30m.docx). Can you confirm who from Redwood will take the architecture & cost slides, who will cover the rollout/ops, and whether we should include a short Q&A for procurement?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

—Lisa
Lisa Moreno
Head of Partnerships, ApexWorks
lisa@apexworks.io

Attachments: apex-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (1 pages, runbook stub), apex-demo-agenda-30m.docx (1 file)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa@apexworks.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rajesh Gupta <r.gupta@si-integrators.com>, AWS Partner Scheduling <aws-partner-scheduling@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ApexWorks x Redwood — multi-sku co-sell demo: logistics & runbook

Thanks Lisa — this looks good. Quick confirmations from our side:
- I’ll take architecture + model routing demo (10m) and show the smart routing fallback between Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
- Vanessa will cover Marketplace positioning + collateral (8m).
- Karthik will cover ops/rollout + SLA/standby strategy (7m).

A few logistics items:
1) Can we standardize on a single slot that works for APAC and US? The Thu Apr 27 slot you proposed (20:00 PT) is ideal for APAC attendance but pushes some of our west-coast guests late. If APAC presence is critical, Thu works; otherwise Tue Apr 25 09:00 PT is more typical.
2) Please loop in the AWS SA who will join — we’ll need a short call-out during the demo for the marketplace listing and any required AMI/packaging notes. I see aws-partner-scheduling on cc; if they can confirm an SA, we’ll add them to the invite.
3) We’ve got an internal runbook update (minor timing switches) — I attached an updated runbook stub (same filename) to this reply for quick scan.

If everyone is comfortable, I’ll propose Thu Apr 27 20:00 PT and send a calendar invite with the shared Drive link.

Connor O'Brien | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--- Original attachments referenced: apex-demo-runbook-v2.pdf, apex-demo-agenda-30m.docx

Date: Sat, 16 Apr 2028 08:42:00 +0530
Subject: Re: ApexWorks x Redwood — multi-sku co-sell demo: logistics & runbook

Thanks — Rajesh here from SI Integrators. Thu Apr 27 20:00 PT should work for our lead engineer, but a small ask: can we shift it 30 minutes earlier (19:30 PT) so our APAC crew can join during a slightly better window? That keeps the overall slot 30 minutes; we can compress the handoffs if needed.

Also:
- We’ll need the runbook to include a short procurement note about reserved capacity pricing thresholds — I can add a paragraph if you send editable docx.
- AWS SA: tagging @aws-partner-scheduling — can you confirm an SA? If they can join for 10 minutes (packaging / marketplace checklist) that’d be perfect.

Rajesh Gupta
Engineering Lead, SI Integrators
r.gupta@si-integrators.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Gupta <r.gupta@si-integrators.com>, Lisa Moreno <lisa@apexworks.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Partner Scheduling <aws-partner-scheduling@amazon.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ApexWorks x Redwood — multi-sku co-sell demo: logistics & runbook

Perfect — thanks Rajesh. We can do Thu Apr 27 19:30 PT (30m). I updated the agenda to compress intros and move ops to the end; attached the invite (.ics) and the latest runbook docx with a placeholder for Rajesh’s procurement paragraph.

Action items (owners):
- Connor: send final slides + shared Drive link (by Mon Apr 24)
- Rajesh: add procurement note to runbook docx (by Tue Apr 25)
- AWS Partner Scheduling: confirm SA and resource for packaging checklist (reply on thread)
- Lisa: confirm final attendee list for ApexWorks and confirm marketing collateral to attach to marketplace listing

I’ll send the calendar invite once SA is confirmed. If AWS cannot join, we’ll record a 5-minute checklist section and circulate.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0203
